title: Taming the Tongue, Wisdom from Above

questions.question: Not many of you should become ____, my brothers, for you know that we who teach will be judged with greater strictness.
questions.explanation: James 3:1 (ESV): "Not many of you should become teachers, my brothers, for you know that we who teach will be judged with greater strictness."

questions.question: For we all stumble in many ways. And if anyone does not stumble in what he says, he is a ____ man, able also to bridle his whole body.
questions.explanation: James 3:2 (ESV): "For we all stumble in many ways. And if anyone does not stumble in what he says, he is a perfect man, able also to bridle his whole body."

questions.question: If we put ____ into the mouths of horses so that they obey us, we guide their whole bodies as well.
questions.explanation: James 3:3 (ESV): "If we put bits into the mouths of horses so that they obey us, we guide their whole bodies as well."

questions.question: Look at the ships also: though they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are guided by a very small ____ wherever the will of the pilot directs.
questions.explanation: James 3:4 (ESV): "Look at the ships also: though they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are guided by a very small rudder wherever the will of the pilot directs."

questions.question: So also the tongue is a small member, yet it boasts of great things. How great a ____ is set ablaze by such a small fire!
questions.explanation: James 3:5 (ESV): "So also the tongue is a small member, yet it boasts of great things. How great a forest is set ablaze by such a small fire!"

questions.question: And the tongue is a ____, a world of unrighteousness.
questions.explanation: James 3:6 (ESV): "And the tongue is a fire, a world of unrighteousness."

questions.question: The tongue is set among our members, staining the whole body, setting on fire the entire course of life, and set on fire by ____.
questions.explanation: James 3:6 (ESV): "The tongue is set among our members, staining the whole body, setting on fire the entire course of life, and set on fire by hell."

questions.question: For every kind of beast and bird, of reptile and sea creature, can be ____ and has been ____ by mankind,
questions.explanation: James 3:7 (ESV): "For every kind of beast and bird, of reptile and sea creature, can be tamed and has been tamed by mankind,"

questions.question: but no human being can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly ____.
questions.explanation: James 3:8 (ESV): "but no human being can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison."

questions.question: With it we bless our Lord and Father, and with it we ____ people who are made in the likeness of God.
questions.explanation: James 3:9 (ESV): "With it we bless our Lord and Father, and with it we curse people who are made in the likeness of God."

questions.question: Does a spring pour forth from the same opening both fresh and ____ water?
questions.explanation: James 3:11 (ESV): "Does a spring pour forth from the same opening both fresh and salt water?"

questions.question: Can a ____ tree, my brothers, bear olives, or a grapevine produce figs? Neither can a salt pond yield fresh water.
questions.explanation: James 3:12 (ESV): "Can a fig tree, my brothers, bear olives, or a grapevine produce figs? Neither can a salt pond yield fresh water."

questions.question: Who is wise and understanding among you? By his good conduct let him show his works in the ____ of wisdom.
questions.explanation: James 3:13 (ESV): "Who is wise and understanding among you? By his good conduct let him show his works in the meekness of wisdom."

questions.question: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ____ in your hearts, do not boast and be false to the truth.
questions.explanation: James 3:14 (ESV): "But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your hearts, do not boast and be false to the truth."

questions.question: But the wisdom from above is first ____, then peaceable, gentle, open to reason, full of mercy and good fruits, impartial and sincere.
questions.explanation: James 3:17 (ESV): "But the wisdom from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, open to reason, full of mercy and good fruits, impartial and sincere."

key_verse_text: With it we bless our Lord and Father, and with it we curse people who are made in the likeness of God. From the same mouth come blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.
